history.origins: Sökö is one of the most popular poker games in Finland and is sometimes known elsewhere as California Stud. It follows standard five-card stud deal and betting structure but uses a distinct hand ranking that adds two hands below a pair: 4-straight and 4-flush.

setup.players: Two to eight players; same as standard five-card stud. Popular in Finland as a home and club game.
setup.dealing: One card face down and one face up to each player initially; then one face-up card per player after each of the next three betting rounds, so each player ends with five cards (one down, four up).

rules.objective: Win pot with best hand. Sökö adds two hands below pair: 4-straight and 4-flush.
rules.gameplay: Same as 5-card stud (1 down, 4 up). Hand order (low to high): high card, pair, 4-straight (4 consecutive + odd card), 4-flush (4 same suit + odd card), two pair, trips, straight, flush, full house, quads, straight flush.
